# 研究报告

比较 PostgreSQL 17 与 MySQL 8.4 的 JSON 索引类型、可加速的查询运算符和索引代价，引用官方文档。

**结果：** `INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE`

## 已核验的部分事实

以下研究项已有原文证据支撑，但整体证据不足以形成完整结论，仅供参考。

### MySQL 8.4 · 命中条件与限制

* Furthermore, multi-valued indexes do not support the ordering of values, making them unsuitable for use as primary keys.

- Evidence: `evidence:e5d5e34344c4a0db6aae1edd5739f9c4935cf952479b7a37`
  - Exact quote: “* Furthermore, multi-valued indexes do not support the ordering of values, making them unsuitable for use as primary keys.”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/ed12c909-3562-4539-9db0-d557b15be1e3/5fbf5b4c69f3230cbac1ff80afed69417e338f1f9d1d1a7317e5bf794ce696a8`
  - URL: https://www.mydbops.com/blog/improving-query-performance-with-multi-valued-indexing-in-mysql-80

### MySQL 8.4 · 官方文档引用

For indexing JSON arrays, use multi-valued indexes instead of generated columns:

- Evidence: `evidence:b51916e11ebde9fd639ccfed6c10139e216b76a80f3d8132`
  - Exact quote: “For indexing JSON arrays, use multi-valued indexes instead of generated columns:”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/3a53a9a7-5835-4933-9f44-27f2a53bedcc/ff7bb86f5601f5b72fa0f5327c6d89a13eea245e94f28e8bed3fb8823bc62b38`
  - URL: https://oneuptime.com/blog/post/2026-03-31-mysql-how-to-index-json-data-using-generated-columns-in-mysql/view

### MySQL 8.4 · 索引代价模型

This allows efficient \`MEMBER OF()\`, \`JSON_CONTAINS()\`, and \`JSON_OVERLAPS()\` queries on JSON array columns without full table scans.

- Evidence: `evidence:08169ba0e24d1273df970eac26bc381bcb5aa4d7035a95e6`
  - Exact quote: “This allows efficient \`MEMBER OF()\`, \`JSON_CONTAINS()\`, and \`JSON_OVERLAPS()\` queries on JSON array columns without full table scans.”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/1f8ae1e9-ab0c-4478-b104-edecc723a3e8/85cd45b27b433b9c47e5dc602e7cb5efd38115734bc01c09728c4361a01dd58b`
  - URL: https://oneuptime.com/blog/post/2026-03-31-mysql-multi-valued-indexes-json-arrays/view

### MySQL 8.4 · JSON 索引类型

General mechanism, (a.k.a. multi-valued index) currently used for JSON arrays

- Evidence: `evidence:6b861e1d113fd85779102b6be1c0a7707a5e1e4ce1a17cdc`
  - Exact quote: “General mechanism, (a.k.a. multi-valued index) currently used for JSON arrays”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/5ccf1043-b3c7-477d-8262-9b939eaee529/5a9108960d0382bcc23a5e7afdb18cee561b82117ac737828742012dc7d58cad`
  - URL: https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/json-array-indexes-in-mysql-226743659/226743659

### PostgreSQL 17 · 可加速的查询运算符

Of the two operator classes for type \`jsonb\`, \`jsonb_ops\` is the default. \`jsonb_path_ops\` supports fewer operators but offers better performance for those operators.

- Evidence: `evidence:b7523e3a08cf748c022750aaf015a42692123b11b41a3a41`
  - Exact quote: “Of the two operator classes for type \`jsonb\`, \`jsonb_ops\` is the default. \`jsonb_path_ops\` supports fewer operators but offers better performance for those operators.”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/b95b43e2-2ddc-478d-add4-6bfcc1e69c47/5f38ab846531d292773e6ebfe4b06b571e6d391a38e8f0180a9adb781f4ff24f`
  - URL: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/gin.html

### PostgreSQL 17 · 命中条件与限制

A \`jsonb_path_ops\` index is usually much smaller than a \`jsonb_ops\` index over the same data, and the specificity of searches is better, particularly when queries contain keys that appear frequently in the data.

- Evidence: `evidence:bd6c2191772726d30f1f0be5690337f1151773ba82dc65f4`
  - Exact quote: “A \`jsonb_path_ops\` index is usually much smaller than a \`jsonb_ops\` index over the same data, and the specificity of searches is better, particularly when queries contain keys that appear frequently in the data.”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/95061a15-3206-4a76-92c9-037b4fc13e6d/9ad7ba30206746bb877a8168edb6e1f5b4a0674f655d1727e115190c0a963544`
  - URL: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/datatype-json.html

### PostgreSQL 17 · 官方文档引用

Although the \`jsonb_path_ops\` operator class supports only queries with the \`@>\`, \`@?\` and \`@@\` operators, it has notable performance advantages over the default operator class \`jsonb_ops\`.

- Evidence: `evidence:267016abe6a34aafaeee9493ae895b37c14eedf73c64efe5`
  - Exact quote: “Although the \`jsonb_path_ops\` operator class supports only queries with the \`@>\`, \`@?\` and \`@@\` operators, it has notable performance advantages over the default operator class \`jsonb_ops\`.”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/9147a0cb-bf26-4968-98df-82682a327bab/c3ef9297d171493b011180eac02bfe4ab30ed2a7e20ff31e93ed458c46a1ef5e`
  - URL: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/datatype-json.html

### PostgreSQL 17 · 索引代价模型

PostgreSQL uses the GIN index type for indexing a column with JSONB data type.

- Evidence: `evidence:7e52535ca9753e71a769f5ffcdf75f1b157a395ad00323ec`
  - Exact quote: “PostgreSQL uses the GIN index type for indexing a column with JSONB data type.”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/f5806843-441d-49d8-8f81-cc92e575d44f/8fe287e22caba87d422c9c8e09833a71be65a0ab7aea750e82d54127011440fd`
  - URL: https://neon.com/postgresql/indexes/json-index

### PostgreSQL 17 · JSON 索引类型

jsonb_ops @> (jsonb,jsonb) @? (jsonb,jsonpath) @@ (jsonb,jsonpath) ? (jsonb,text) ?| (jsonb,text[]) ?& (jsonb,text[])

- Evidence: `evidence:4e412886615d6f1ad1f11d26d95b2d921d7b2981e2680afe`
  - Exact quote: “jsonb_ops @> (jsonb,jsonb) @? (jsonb,jsonpath) @@ (jsonb,jsonpath) ? (jsonb,text) ?| (jsonb,text[]) ?& (jsonb,text[])”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/daaaa457-42c1-45c1-97e1-0666a596ee6e/935069734da4e05d7ce40b60382a193301457e6cfd54e6fd2c2ded2db8c86a84`
  - URL: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/gin.html

## 局限与未解决项

- **MySQL 8.4 · 可加速的查询运算符**：必需研究项未找到足够证据（`REQUIRED_CELL_UNRESOLVED`，`GAP`）

## 完成判定原因

- INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE

This allows efficient `MEMBER OF()`, `JSON_CONTAINS()`, and `JSON_OVERLAPS()` queries on JSON array columns without full table scans.
For indexing JSON arrays, use multi-valued indexes instead of generated columns:

A `jsonb_path_ops` index is usually much smaller than a `jsonb_ops` index over the same data, and the specificity of searches is better, particularly when queries contain keys that appear frequently in the data.
Of the two operator classes for type `jsonb`, `jsonb_ops` is the default. `jsonb_path_ops` supports fewer operators but offers better performance for those operators.

* Furthermore, multi-valued indexes do not support the ordering of values, making them unsuitable for use as primary keys.
